info.name: Drawbridge · 06 Staff task
info.description: Creates a staff task in Veradigm EHR (the phone agent's only EHR write). Never changes the chart.

exec: pm.test('No Unity error', () => pm.expect(body).to.not.match(/Magic Error|"Error"\s*:|not valid for this license|Access is denied/i));

{
  "Action": "SaveTask",
  "Appname": "{{app_name}}",

  "PatientID": "{{ehr_patient_id}}",
  "Token": "{{ehr_token}}",
  "Parameter1": "Call Patient",
  "Parameter2": "{{task_target}}",
  "Parameter3": "",
  "Parameter4": "Drawbridge sandbox test task, please ignore",
  "Parameter5": "Drawbridge test",
  "Parameter6": "",
  "Data": ""
}

request.description:
P1 task type, P2 user or team that gets the task, P3 work object ID (blank), P4 comments, P5 subject.

Target: Veradigm EHR. Run the **01 Auth** collection first (token for EHR).
